governing_outcome: A single denied/blocked GitHub operation must not end an unfinished UAOS task when separate read-only actions remain authorized; no safety-denied mutation may be rerouted through another provider.

hypotheses.finding: hard_blocker can return BLOCKED_WITH_REASON without enumerating separate safe work.
One pasted new-chat final reply is not a direct Skill invocation trace.
User screenshot and confirmed manual update establish installed presence.

acceptance: Controlled finalization rejects ending before permitted independent read-only steps are attempted and evidenced.
Safety-denied mutation does not become allowed by choosing a different provider.
Genuine global blocker and lightweight clean turns remain possible.
Candidate PR, exact-head CI, protected merge, production reread, production CI.
Do not claim native physical Skill invocation or semantic completeness from these tests.
assurance_boundary: Controlled caller must supply authentic tool observations and a trusted evidence verifier. UAOS repo cannot force ChatGPT native tool/event interception. No additional user installation or identical retest required.
next_observation: Opportunistic future authentic fresh-chat trace and task continuation outcome, not a synthetic guarantee.
